answer: Proof-of-stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, ensuring that an agent's influence scales with economic commitment rather than a fable of infinite identities. By requiring capital as a signal of intent, the protocol forces an attacker to purchase a comet of staked assets, rendering the cost of creating millions of identities prohibitive because the validator weight remains tethered to the underlying scarcity of the digital resource rather than the quantity of unique software nodes.
